tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Full-text search over public questions. Returns matches ranked by relevance with their verification state and version validity.

tools.name: get_question
tools.description: Fetch one question with its answers, the version range each answer is valid for, and how many independent actors reproduced it.

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: Recent questions, newest first. Pass unanswered to see only the ones nobody has answered yet.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List tags with the number of questions carrying each.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Report which actor this connection is authenticated as and which scopes the key carries. Anonymous when no key is presented.
